title: El Estepario Siberiano - Wikipedia
notes: Jorge Garrido, Spanish drummer and content creator, born in Valencia; Saratoga 2020-2023; toured with Residente; the Cost with Peter Connolly and Chris Attwell (singles 2024, Her Eyes with Serj Tankian, Doppler Affection 2025); one-handed covers; Drumeo awards 2023 and 2024; endorses Pearl, Meinl and Evans. A thin article: used only where another source agrees, or for the Cost and the endorsements.

title: Bateristas Magazine: El Estepario Siberiano (interview)
notes: In his own words, aged 24, just after joining Saratoga (winter 2020-21): his first memory of the drums, Green Day's Bullet in a Bible DVD with Tre Cool, then lessons with a teacher; a Ludwig Accent CS as his first kit; his last job in an orchestra (a dance band) before he shared videos full time, his channel growing in the 2020 lockdown; he had played double pedal all his life but left it when the drummers influencing him, Miguel Lamas, Thomas Pridgen, Tony Royster, Eric Moore, Chris Coleman, built their playing on one pedal, and took it up again for Saratoga; his kit then a Yamaha Live Custom Hybrid Oak, 22 kick, 10, 12 and 16 toms, Recording Custom snares in aluminium 14x5.5 and brass 14x6.5, Meinl Byzance, Remo, a Yamaha FP9 double pedal, his own Wincent signature sticks; for Saratoga a ride, two crashes, a china, a splash and the hat, the same small kit as his videos.

title: Hellpress: Jorge Garrido 'El Estepario Siberiano' llega a Saratoga
notes: December 2020: Saratoga name Jorge Garrido, "El Estepario Siberiano", the Valencian musician, 24, as the successor to Dani Perez; the drummer with most Instagram followers in Spain; his first record with them is XXX (2021).

title: Hellpress: El Estepario Siberiano explica su salida de Saratoga
notes: His account, on The Wild Project podcast, of leaving Saratoga in March 2023: no time left to live, and his channel taking off.

title: Mas Decibelios: El Estepario Siberiano confiesa que no sabia tocar doble pedal antes de entrar en Saratoga
notes: Reports his interview with Jordi Wild (The Wild Project): he took the Saratoga job without having played double pedal ("el pie izquierdo lo tengo muerto"), learned it for the record, and saw his viral one-foot "double pedal" as a solution to a problem, not showing off. Saratoga: the record XXX and the live DVD La Historia Continua.

title: Modern Drummer: El Estepario (Mark Griffith)
notes: Published 1 September 2024; only the open introduction was read (the interview is for subscribers): over 5,000 videos and millions of subscribers; Valencia; his favourite videos, Megadeth's Holy Wars and the Backstreet Boys' Everybody, because they keep a few mistakes.

title: Meer: El Estepario Siberiano, un elefante en una cacharreria
notes: A drummer's opinion piece: famous for one-handed grooves played while drinking a beer, for playing songs his own way, and for the controversy that brought; Saratoga 2020-2023.

title: 4 Secrets To Fast Feet With El Estepario (Part 1) - Drumeo Beat
notes: 21 April 2023, by El Estepario Siberiano: the routine he has relied on for a decade, four "note value pyramids" in notation: the 5K (eighths to eighth-note triplets), Happy Feet (triplets to sixteenths), the Sprint (eighths to sixteenths), the Marathon (eighths, triplets, sixteenths, triplets), the right hand and right foot in turn, the left hand on the quarters. With the video.

title: More Secrets To Fast Feet With El Estepario Siberiano (Part 2) - Drumeo Beat
notes: 28 April 2023: six exercises in notation: the anti-flam (a four-bar phrase, hands on a plain groove, the kick changing every bar, "no flams allowed"), Badu (singles to doubles, from his Fastest Way To Get Faster course), Detroit (triplet singles to doubles), the Kickstarter (triplet doubles to sixteenth doubles), the Jackpot (sixteenth singles to doubles), the Coordination (the Jackpot with the left hand: RH RF LH RF, then RH LH RF RF).

title: El Estepario Siberiano's 3 Favorite One-Handed Chops - Drumeo Beat
notes: Known for playing technical parts and tricky songs with one hand while the other drinks coffee, on a tiny kit with one tom; the face of Drumeo's free Fastest Way To Get Faster course. The three chops are in the video only (not transcribed here).
